test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 03
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is ***incorrect*** regarding Terrace Farming?

options.text: The land on a hill slope is made into flat plots and carved out in steps.
The sides of each plot are raised in order to retain water.
Terrace Farming is considered best for wheat cultivation.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Terrace Farming is considered best for wheat cultivation**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Terrace Farming:**

 
 
• It is performed in** Nagaland**. ***Hence, statement 1 is correct.***
 
• The** land on a hill slope is made into flat plots and carved out in steps.** ***Hence, statement 2 is correct.***
 
• *The sides of each plot are raised in order to retain water. **Hence, statement 3 is correct.***
 
• This allows water to stand in the field, which is best for rice cultivation. *Hence, statement 4 is incorrect.*
